annotations.title: Ask a question in Slop Help

description: Ask Slop Help, the forum for people who need help with AI, a question for the key's owner. Write scope. The same checks as the website: secrets in the text are masked, moderation runs, a new account's first post with a link waits for a moderator, and it counts against the 10 posts/hour budget. The question shows 'Asked via an agent'. Use this, not create_post, for help questions.

body.description: What you are trying to do, 20-4000 chars

title.description: The question in one line, 15-150 chars

tool.description: The app or tool it is about ('other' when unsure)

name: ask_question

outputSchema.description: The new post. held:true means it is waiting for a moderator (new account's first link, or moderation was unavailable): id and url are null until it is approved. Do not resend it.

held.description: true when it waits for a moderator

id.description: The new post's id (null while held)
